teamMembers.name: Odd Bob
teamMembers.bio: Tiriad i bigfoot ned im. (Gwarth: mel e cofí eria)
teamMembers.longBio: Bob olant ned i Ered Kaskád, teliad ned i taur ah gwedeir bigfoot dîn. Lathron o thurin an int in ithaear. Pethron o thenid al-beth gwaith in Arda. Herdir o neth Abide.

teamMembers.name: Dr. Kitsune
teamMembers.bio: Iston in gwath ah i lhûg. (Gwarth: Al-mer i cofí)
teamMembers.longBio: Iston o theled. Celeb o ithaear a valar. Iston o faer. Dír o fuin ned i fair in Elyn. Palantír in Ered.

teamMembers.name: Saoirse
teamMembers.bio: Faer Íweri ah thûl i annûn. (Gwarth: Mel e uisge beatha)
teamMembers.longBio: Saoirse i taur a brith in peth. Tuio o i-tal en Eriodor, i faer thilia thûl, pen-nauth a gela.

teamMembers.name: Rest
teamMembers.bio: Glaer o thurin. Emaer lîn sî.
